Clearance and ground checks pass; 43,730 triangles, no warnings.
issues: The chest reads more purple than the mockup's grey-violet.
The resting sword tip sits close to the ground in the front view.
dark-knight.next: Optional: desaturate the wing panels one step; raise the rest grip a few degrees.

wight.summary: Elf-like wight king on the vampire base: rusted iron crown over white shoulder-length locks, large navy eyes with a pale ring and glints, pointed ears, dark leather armor with a chest strap and rust bracers, tattered cape, rusted sword. Reviewed 8.0 after three passes (one feedback pass, one fresh rework).
strengths: The eyes match the mockup: navy iris, pale sclera ring, black pupil, two glints.
Hair is seven shoulder-length locks; the cape and armor show below it in the back view.
Clearance and ground checks pass; 48,380 triangles, no warnings.
issues: The hair top under the crown still reads as a smooth white dome in the side sprites.
The breastplate lacks embossed relief; the face has less brow and cheek sculpt than the mockup.
wight.next: Optional: break the hair dome with two or three raised locks; add an embossed plate line.

revenant.summary: Undead soldier on the zombie-soldier base: cracked iron helm with a nasal spade, brow rim, cheek flaps and a red plume; mismatched eyes (black pit, orange with a pupil) in dark sockets; stitched grin; pointed ears; crossed leather straps over a tattered teal-grey tunic; rusted axe and round shield. Reviewed 8.0 after one feedback pass.
strengths: The mismatched eyes, plume, cracked helm and shield read at 128 px.
Silhouette and colors match the mockup in all four views.
Clearance and ground checks pass; 49,284 triangles, no warnings.
issues: The plume is three spikes rather than the mockup's curled stub.
The shoulder leather caps hide under the pauldrons; the bracer is a plain cone.
revenant.next: Optional: curl the plume with a chain; wrap the bracer with two strap rings.

orc-warlord.summary: Orc chieftain on the orc-warrior base: horned iron helm with a red crest, yellow eyes in dark sockets, jaw tusks, red-brown beard, huge spiked riveted pauldrons with fur trim, chest harness, studded belt and hand-print tabard, tall iron boots with skull bosses, a broad double-headed axe held across the body. Reviewed 8.0 after one feedback pass.
strengths: The horns, crest, pauldrons and double axe give the mockup's silhouette in every sprite direction.
Lit rims and rivets keep the iron from reading as flat black at 128 px.
Clearance and ground checks pass; 68,024 triangles, no warnings.
issues: The skin still renders one step brighter than the mockup.
The beard hides the chest harness; the red hand print sits behind the axe haft in the front view.
orc-warlord.next: Optional: darken the skin one more step; shorten the beard so the harness emblem shows.

bandit-captain.summary: Outlaw leader on the bandit base: wide flat-brim hat with a red feather, red bandana, eyepatch, full beard with a curled mustache, red neckerchief, long flared black coat with lapels and brass buttons over a brown vest and buckled belt, hooked cutlass and dagger. Reviewed 8.0 after three passes (one feedback pass, one fresh rework).
strengths: The hat, feather, coat and cutlass read in every sprite direction.
The beard and mustache now separate; the bandana shows under the brim.
Clearance and ground checks pass; 50,732 triangles, no warnings.
issues: The coat folds read weakly because the lit tones sit close to the base color.
The hat brim hides the face in the top-down sprite angle.
bandit-captain.next: Optional: lighten the lapel and cuff tones one step; tilt the hat brim up at the front by a few degrees.

iron-golem.summary: Blocky riveted iron construct on the stone-golem rig: chamfered plates, a small faceted head with a glowing visor slit and a rust spike, a rusty riveted furnace hatch, bent arms with chamfered knuckle fists, box legs with vents and three-toed feet, rust streaks from every rivet. Reviewed 8.0 after one feedback pass.
strengths: The boxy silhouette, rivets and rust read in every sprite direction.
The iron value now separates from the shadows at 128 px.
Ground check passes; 24,562 triangles, no warnings; no held items.
issues: The visor glow renders pale peach rather than saturated orange at sprite size.
The legs are shorter and more upright than the mockup's tapered blocks.
iron-golem.next: Optional: darken the visor base so the emissive core stays orange; lengthen the shins by 0.03 m.

gargoyle.summary: Crouching winged stone demon on the imp rig: ridged horns, a spine crest, angry yellow eyes under heavy brows, a fanged grin, carved chest and belly bands, big bat wings with thick rims and elbow claws, a spade-tipped tail, dark grey stone with moss stains. Reviewed 8.0 after one feedback pass.
strengths: The spread wings, horns, yellow eyes and grin read in every sprite direction.
The stone value separates from the shadows at 128 px.
Ground check passes; 40,678 triangles, no warnings; no held items.
issues: The wing membranes are flat panels without the mockup's carved relief.
The tail is half hidden by the leg in the front sprite.
gargoyle.next: Optional: add two curved membrane ridges per wing in bump; raise the tail 0.05 m.

banshee.summary: Screaming banshee: a gaunt grey-green face with glowing cyan eyes and a wide toothed scream, a white mane of thirty hooked locks that stream up and back, a wrapped collar over a folded gown with cyan drips, and four broad twisting ribbon wisps with a cyan core that reach the ground. Reviewed 8.0 after two builds, two feedback passes, and two fresh reworks (Sonnet 5.5 high tier).
strengths: The white mane, the glowing face, the gown, and the cyan ribbons read at 128 px in all eight directions.
The head is one third of the body and the scream reads.
Ground ok, 55,154 triangles, no warnings, no held items.
issues: The locks are thick tubes; the mockup strands are thinner and more flame-like.
The face is smoother than the mockup's gaunt skull.
The ribbons are still band-like next to the mockup's sheets.
banshee.next: Thin the lock tips to r 0.003, add cheek hollows, and widen the ribbons to 0.14 m at the hem.

specter.summary: Floating hooded phantom on the wraith base: a deep peaked hood over a black void face with two glowing green eyes, layered scarf bands, a grey-blue robe with a torn front panel and hem, dark bony arms with clawed hands and wrist chains, curling green mist at the hem. Reviewed 8.0 after three passes (one feedback pass, one fresh rework).
strengths: The hood, green eyes and mist read in every sprite direction.
The cloth reads as smooth matte clay in the textured build.
Clearance and ground checks pass; 45,884 triangles, no warnings.
issues: The cowl is a smooth stacked collar rather than crumpled scarf folds.
The robe is a wide cylinder; the mockup tapers to a narrower hem.
specter.next: Optional: displace the top scarf band with a low-frequency fold; taper the robe profile by 0.03 at the hem.

poltergeist.summary: Grinning pale violet ghost on the ghost base: a wide egg head with big glossy black eyes under mischievous brows, a huge square-toothed grin, thumbs-up fists, a short scalloped sheet body, and four orbiting objects (stool, plate, candlestick, book) on their own bones that circle in every clip. Reviewed 8.0 after one feedback pass.
strengths: The eyes and grin read at 128 px in the front directions.
The orbiting objects give a unique silhouette in every direction.
Ground check passes; 27,596 triangles, no warnings; no held items.
issues: The grin corners do not curl up like the mockup's.
The stool and candle sit close together in some directions.
poltergeist.next: Optional: curve the mouth cut upward at the corners; spread the orbit offsets evenly at 90 degrees.

vampire-lord.summary: Regal armored vampire on the vampire base: slicked black hair with a widow's peak, pale grey skin, heavy brows, red glowing eyes, a fanged grimace, a red-lined high collar, a black cloak with a bat-wing hem, a gold-trimmed black breastplate with pauldrons, a gold-buckled belt, black boots, clawed hands. Reviewed 8.0 on the first build.
strengths: The collar, hair peak, red eyes and cloak hem read in every sprite direction.
The silhouette and colors match the mockup in all four views.
Clearance and ground checks pass; 41,674 triangles, no warnings.
issues: The eyes render pink rather than deep red because the emissive washes the base.
The gold trim is thinner than the mockup's ornate bat crest.
vampire-lord.next: Optional: darken the eye base to #8a0a0a under the emissive; add a bat-crest emblem outline to the chest.

troll-guard.summary: Hunched troll on the orc-warrior base: a big warty nose, small blue eyes under a heavy brow, an underbite with fat curved tusks, long pointed ears, a shaggy rope mane to the belly, a small cross-hatched riveted iron helmet, a patched torn kilt with a rope belt, and a banded studded club over the right shoulder. Reviewed 8.0 after one feedback pass.
strengths: The tusks, helmet, mane and club read in every sprite direction.
The face matches the mockup's expression: brow, nose, underbite.
Clearance and ground checks pass; 64,732 triangles, no warnings.
issues: The skin renders one step greener than the mockup's muted clay.
The club head is smaller than the mockup's flared drum head.
troll-guard.next: Optional: shift the skin toward #7a8a66; widen the club head to r 0.11.

clay-golem.summary: Stocky terracotta construct on the stone-golem rig: a rounded head with hollow eyes, a slot mouth and an amber forehead gem in a rim, big pressed-clay shoulders, a carved rune word on the chest and a shield panel on the belly, short thick arms with blocky hands, thick legs with knee pads and wide three-toed feet, pressed seams and cracks. Reviewed 8.0 after one feedback pass.
strengths: The silhouette matches the mockup in every sprite direction.

summoner.summary: A P1 hero on the priest base, built by a Sonnet 5.5 subagent in one build, one feedback pass, and a fresh hair rework: violet hair of 16 chain locks under a thin gold circlet, a long violet braid over the left shoulder, violet eyes, a green robe open over a cream front with gold edges and a gold collar band, a brown belt with a green gem and chain links, a brown book in the left hand, and a lime spirit with a face and leaf wings off the +X shoulder. The owner accepted it at 7.8 on 2026-10-01.
strengths: The violet hair, the green robe with its cream front, and the lime spirit give three clear color masses at 128 px.
The spirit, the book, and the gem belt make the summoner role clear from the front.
It shares the round beardless face, proportions, and clip set of the other P1 heroes.
issues: From the side and the back, the hair locks read as crossing ropes, not the swept mane of the mockup.
The spirit is a smooth lime blob; the mockup shows a small golden creature with a round face.
The robe lacks the long flared coat tails of the mockup.
summoner.next: Accepted by the owner at 7.8 (2026-10-01). A later polish pass could sweep the back locks in one direction and add coat tails.
